bullets.text: Activists and residents in Chennai are strongly protesting threats to the Nemmeli coastal wetland and Pallikaranai marshland, and the office should monitor these environmental disputes.
Traders staged a road roko in Gummidipoondi on the GNT Road after authorities demolished encroached shops, and the office should watch for further local unrest.
A woman was killed by a speeding bike while crossing the road in Gummidipoondi, and local police must ensure stricter traffic enforcement.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay will share the stage with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Chennai on October 11, marking their first joint public appearance.
Power supply will be suspended in Velachery and other Chennai areas for maintenance work, and the office should track utility schedules.
The Greater Chennai Corporation is using drones to spray larvicide along waterways to combat dengue and mosquito breeding, and the office should support public health drives.
The Kuppai Pirippom campaign has successfully boosted waste segregation across south Chennai households, and the constituency team should promote these sanitation habits.
A fire broke out at the ghee lamp lighting area in the Thiruttani Murugan temple, and district authorities must inspect temple safety measures.
The Avadi Police Commissionerate conducted a three-day special drive against history-sheeters to maintain public peace, and the district team should review crime statistics.
Farmers in Thiruvallur faced hardship at direct paddy procurement centers due to middlemen interfering with Andhra paddy sales, and the district team must intervene.
The IT department's iTNT Hub launched an AI-Focused Pre-Incubation Program for artificial intelligence innovators, and the portfolio team should track startup participation.
An IIT Madras study revealed that educated professionals are falling victim to digital financial cyber scams, and the portfolio team should promote enhanced cybersecurity awareness.
TIDCO has invited bids for a feasibility study to set up a 400-crore fintech hub in Coimbatore, and the portfolio team should monitor project advancements.
TVK flags suddenly appeared on encroached shops along the Gummidipoondi GNT Road ahead of an eviction drive, and the office should watch local political developments.
Actor Jai stated at Coimbatore airport that public confidence in the TVK administration is growing and predicted victory in the Tharapuram by-election.
